notes: Site Routines: Group up to 5 websites into a single Routine shortcut and open them all together in one click.
Existing Website Picker: Quickly reuse saved favorites, folder sites, routines, or top sites when adding bookmarks without retyping URLs.
Redesigned Setup Wizard: Enjoy a new welcome screen with instant backup restore, real-time live appearance previews, and dedicated search and privacy steps.
Solid Color Background Presets: Choose from 8 accent-tuned solid color backgrounds with automatic light and dark mode variants.
Live Ping Latency Badge: See your real-time connection latency (in ms) directly inside the Network Status header widget.
Smarter Search Suggestions: View your 5 most recent history visits on an empty search bar, with best-match ranking as you type.
Refined Clear Glass & Search Icons: Enjoy cleaner clear glass surfaces across light and dark modes, plus crisp icons for all supported search engines.
Pomodoro & Widget Fixes: Improved Firefox completion notifications, prevented duplicate timer alerts, fixed the exported Daily Summary image across Chrome and Firefox, and polished countdown rings.
